headline: ARI @ MIA matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is ARI 4.08 at MIA 4.81, with a projected total of 8.88. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward MIA: ARI moved +0.39 runs while MIA moved +1.28, changing the projected margin by -0.89 runs. The projected total climbed +1.67, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -15.6%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Tyler Phillips has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.4 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Otto Lopez, Heriberto Hernández, Corbin Carroll, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Owen Caissie, Ildemaro Vargas because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
